result.title: Tight Learned Event-Inertial Odometry (TLEIO): a Transformer-Based Architecture for End-to-End Motion from Event Streams
result.summary: Event cameras provide microsecond temporal resolution, high dynamic range, and sparse asynchronous measurements, making them compelling for odometry under fast motion and challenging illumination. Yet, accurate event-based state estimation remains difficult: existing systems often use events as a complement to frames or rely on feature tracking, correspondence search, and optimization-heavy backends, limiting the efficiency promised by event sensing. We introduce Tight Learned Event-Inertial Odometry (TLEIO), a compact filter-based pipeline that learns short-window relative motion directly from voxelized event streams and tightly fuses the resulting constraints with IMU propagation. Its learned front-end, EventsFormer, predicts local displacements and per-axis uncertainty from event voxels in a single forward pass, while a stochastic-cloning EKF fuses these overlapping predictions with IMU propagation, producing metric trajectories without explicit feature tracks and pose optimization at inference time. The network is trained directly from pose displacements, without requiring event-flow labels. We evaluate TLEIO on the TartanAir/TartanEvent benchmark and on real DAVIS240c sequences. On TartanAir, TLEIO reduces average ATE from 2.26 m to 1.10 m over the IMU-only TLIO baseline, while achieving up to 48.9% lower runtime than optimization-based event odometry methods.

AI.brief_summary: TLEIO 提出紧凑的滤波式事件-惯性里程计：EventsFormer 前端从体素化事件流单次前向预测短窗相对位移与各轴不确定性，再由随机克隆 EKF 与 IMU 紧耦合，直接用位姿位移训练并在 TartanAir 与 DAVIS240c 上评测。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「一次前向同时给出运动估计与逐轴不确定性、再按不确定性加权融合」的机制，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据可靠度估计及何时采信/停止的决策提供方法线索；但事件相机里程计与多模态推理主线距离较远，需人工核查可迁移性。
